$comment: Temporary, justified acceptances for `npm audit` high/critical findings in the
admin UI. Enforced by scripts/npm-audit-gate.sh — see that script for the rules.
An entry is only legitimate when the advisory is provably not exploitable in
this codebase AND no non-breaking patched version exists yet. Always prefer
upgrading. Every entry MUST carry a reason and a near-term `expires` date; the
gate fails once that date passes, so nothing can be quietly forgotten.

advisories.reason: RSC-mode CSRF bypass. Not reachable here: the admin UI is a client-only Vite SPA that imports solely from 'react-router-dom' (no RSC entry points, no server actions, no route handlers). The advisory is fixed in react-router 8.3.0, but react-router-dom ends at 7.18.1 (v8 folds it back into react-router), so clearing this needs a deliberate v8 migration rather than a version bump. Tracked for that migration; do not renew this entry a second time without one.
